title: Quantum imaginary Schur-Weyl duality
summary: We study quiver Hecke algebras of untwisted affine type $A$ with an arbitrary choice of parameters and establish a duality with the Iwahori-Hecke algebra of the symmetric group. The parameter $t$ of the Iwahori-Hecke algebra is explicitly determined by the parameters defining the quiver Hecke algebra. This duality provides a deformation of the imaginary Schur-Weyl duality introduced by Kleshchev and Muth.
